\title "Loop edge 10: ties and let ring"
\tempo 120
.
:2 0.1 2.1 |
// Tie across the barline.
:2 -.1 :4 3.1 3.1 |
\ro :1 5.1 |
:2 -.1 7.1 |
// Tie from inside the repeat into the first ending.
\ae 1 \rc 2 :1 -.1 |
// The second ending continues a tie whose origin differs by pass.
\ae 2 :1 -.1 |
:1 -.1 |
:4 0.1{lr} 2.1{lr} 3.1 5.1
